examples.question: What is the total number of patients screened for blood pressure?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total_screened FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic IS NOT NULL AND avg_diastolic IS NOT NULL
examples.description: Count distinct patients with BP readings

examples.question: Show the total population screened for BP
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_screened FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic IS NOT NULL OR avg_diastolic IS NOT NULL
examples.description: Total records with any BP measurement

examples.question: How many patients have elevated blood pressure?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS elevated_bp_count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic >= 140 OR avg_diastolic >= 90
examples.description: Count patients with high BP (systolic >= 140 or diastolic >= 90)

examples.question: What is the average systolic blood pressure by gender?
examples.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(avg_systolic) AS avg_systolic, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gender
examples.description: Average systolic BP grouped by gender

examples.question: Show blood pressure distribution by age group
examples.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN age < 30 THEN 'Under 30' WHEN age BETWEEN 30 AND 50 THEN '30-50' WHEN age BETWEEN 51 AND 70 THEN '51-70' ELSE 'Over 70' END AS age_group, AVG(avg_systolic) AS avg_systolic, AVG(avg_diastolic) AS avg_diastolic, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE age IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
examples.description: BP stats by age brackets using CASE expression

examples.question: Compare initial and latest blood pressure readings for patients
examples.sql: WITH ranked_readings AS (SELECT patient_id, avg_systolic, avg_diastolic, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at ASC) AS first_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS last_rank FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic IS NOT NULL) SELECT f.patient_id, f.avg_systolic AS initial_systolic, l.avg_systolic AS latest_systolic, l.avg_systolic - f.avg_systolic AS systolic_change FROM ranked_readings f JOIN ranked_readings l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id WHERE f.first_rank = 1 AND l.last_rank = 1 LIMIT 100
examples.description: Compare first and last BP readings using ROW_NUMBER in CTE

examples.question: Find patients with consecutive high blood pressure readings
examples.sql: WITH numbered AS (SELECT patient_id, avg_systolic, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at) AS rn FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic >= 140), grouped AS (SELECT patient_id, avg_systolic, created_at, rn, rn - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at) AS grp FROM numbered) SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS consecutive_high_readings, MIN(created_at) AS streak_start, MAX(created_at) AS streak_end FROM grouped GROUP BY patient_id, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY consecutive_high_readings DESC
examples.description: Detect consecutive high BP readings using ROW_NUMBER difference technique

examples.question: What is the monthly trend of patient screenings?
examples.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patients_screened, AVG(avg_systolic) AS avg_systolic FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', created_at) ORDER BY month
examples.description: Monthly screening stats using DATE_TRUNC

examples.question: Show the latest reading for each patient
examples.sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT patient_id, avg_systolic, avg_diastolic, created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY created_at DESC) AS rn FROM clinical_data_latest) SELECT patient_id, avg_systolic, avg_diastolic, created_at FROM latest WHERE rn = 1 LIMIT 100
examples.description: Get most recent reading per patient using ROW_NUMBER in CTE

examples.question: Count patients by risk level
examples.sql: SELECT risk_level, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE risk_level IS NOT NULL GROUP BY risk_level ORDER BY patient_count DESC
examples.description: Patient distribution by risk level

examples.question: Find patients screened in the last 90 days
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS recent_patients FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days'
examples.description: Count patients screened in last 90 days using INTERVAL syntax

examples.question: What percentage of patients have hypertension?
examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN avg_systolic >= 140 OR avg_diastolic >= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS hypertension_percentage FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE avg_systolic IS NOT NULL
examples.description: Calculate percentage with hypertension using CASE WHEN

examples.question: Show top 10 sites by patient count
examples.sql: SELECT site_id, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE site_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY site_id ORDER BY patient_count DESC LIMIT 10
examples.description: Top sites ranked by patient volume

examples.question: Calculate BMI statistics by gender
examples.sql: SELECT gender, AVG(bmi) AS avg_bmi, MIN(bmi) AS min_bmi, MAX(bmi) AS max_bmi, COUNT(*) AS count FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE bmi IS NOT NULL AND gender IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gender
examples.description: BMI aggregation statistics by gender

examples.question: Find patients with glucose readings above normal
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS high_glucose_patients FROM clinical_data_latest WHERE glucose_value > 100
examples.description: Count patients with elevated glucose

examples.question: Show BP data with facility hierarchy (country, county, subcounty) and program name
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, hf.name AS facility_name, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, co.id AS country_id, co.name AS country, dis.id AS county_id, dis.name AS county_name, chif.id AS subcounty_id, chif.name AS subcounty_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN country_admin_gold co ON hf.country_id = co.id LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id LEFT JOIN chiefdom_admin_gold chif ON hf.chiefdom_id = chif.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, COALESCE(MAX(pg.name), 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT bl.*, f.facility_name, f.country, f.county_name, f.subcounty_name, COALESCE(fp.program_name, 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM bp_log_gold bl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = bl.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id
examples.description: M&E pattern: Enrich BP data with full facility hierarchy (country → district/county → chiefdom/subcounty) and program assignments using CTEs

examples.question: Get latest BP readings with facility details from October 2024 onwards
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, hf.name AS facility_name, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, co.name AS country, dis.name AS county_name, chif.name AS subcounty_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN country_admin_gold co ON hf.country_id = co.id LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id LEFT JOIN chiefdom_admin_gold chif ON hf.chiefdom_id = chif.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE) SELECT bl.patient_id, bl.avg_systolic, bl.avg_diastolic, bl.bp_taken_on, bl.cvd_risk_level, f.facility_name, f.country, f.county_name, f.subcounty_name FROM bp_log_gold bl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = bl.organization_id WHERE TRY_CAST(bl.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND TRY_CAST(bl.bp_taken_on AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
examples.description: M&E pattern: Latest BP readings with facility details, date-filtered

examples.question: Count patients by program and county
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, dis.name AS county_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, COALESCE(MAX(pg.name), 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT f.county_name, COALESCE(fp.program_name, 'Unassigned') AS program_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS patient_count FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY f.county_name, fp.program_name ORDER BY patient_count DESC
examples.description: M&E pattern: Patient counts aggregated by program and geographic region

examples.question: Show screening volumes by facility and month
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, hf.name AS facility_name, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE) SELECT f.facility_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', sl.bp_taken_on) AS month, COUNT(DISTINCT sl.patient_id) AS patients_screened, COUNT(*) AS total_screenings FROM screening_log_gold sl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = sl.organization_id WHERE sl.bp_taken_on IS NOT NULL GROUP BY f.facility_name, DATE_TRUNC('month', sl.bp_taken_on) ORDER BY month DESC, patients_screened DESC
examples.description: M&E pattern: Monthly screening volumes by facility

examples.question: Show glucose log data with facility hierarchy and program name
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, hf.name AS facility_name, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, co.id AS country_id, co.name AS country, dis.id AS county_id, dis.name AS county_name, chif.id AS subcounty_id, chif.name AS subcounty_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN country_admin_gold co ON hf.country_id = co.id LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id LEFT JOIN chiefdom_admin_gold chif ON hf.chiefdom_id = chif.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, COALESCE(MAX(pg.name), 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT gl.patient_id, gl.glucose_type, gl.glucose_value, gl.glucose_unit, gl.hba1c, gl.bg_taken_on, f.facility_name, f.country, f.county_name, f.subcounty_name, COALESCE(fp.program_name, 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM glucose_log_latest_gold gl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = gl.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id
examples.description: M&E pattern: Enrich glucose log data with full facility hierarchy and program assignments using CTEs

examples.question: Get glucose readings with facility details from October 2024 onwards
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, hf.name AS facility_name, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, co.name AS country, dis.name AS county_name, chif.name AS subcounty_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN country_admin_gold co ON hf.country_id = co.id LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id LEFT JOIN chiefdom_admin_gold chif ON hf.chiefdom_id = chif.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, COALESCE(MAX(pg.name), 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT gl.patient_id, gl.glucose_type, gl.glucose_value, gl.hba1c, TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) AS bg_taken_on, f.facility_name, f.country, f.county_name, f.subcounty_name, COALESCE(fp.program_name, 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM glucose_log_latest_gold gl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = gl.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-10-01' AND TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
examples.description: M&E pattern: Glucose readings with facility details, date-filtered

examples.question: Count glucose readings by program and county
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, dis.name AS county_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, COALESCE(MAX(pg.name), 'Unassigned') AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT f.county_name, COALESCE(fp.program_name, 'Unassigned') AS program_name, COUNT(DISTINCT gl.patient_id) AS patient_count, COUNT(*) AS reading_count FROM glucose_log_latest_gold gl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = gl.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id GROUP BY f.county_name, fp.program_name ORDER BY patient_count DESC
examples.description: M&E pattern: Glucose reading counts aggregated by program and geographic region

examples.question: How many individuals screened for blood pressure from January 2026 to date?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS individuals_screened_bp FROM bp_log_gold WHERE TRY_CAST(bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND TRY_CAST(bp_taken_on AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE AND is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count distinct individuals with BP screening in date range

examples.question: How many individuals screened for BP who are smokers from January 2026 to date?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bp.patient_id) AS smokers_screened_bp FROM bp_log_gold bp INNER JOIN patient_lifestyle_gold pl ON bp.patient_id = pl.patient_id WHERE pl.smoking_status IN ('Current smoker', 'Smoker', 'Yes') AND TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count BP-screened individuals who are smokers

examples.question: How many individuals screened for glucose from January 2026 to date?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS individuals_screened_glucose FROM glucose_log_gold WHERE TRY_CAST(bg_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND TRY_CAST(bg_taken_on AS DATE) <= CURRENT_DATE
examples.description: M&E: Count distinct individuals with glucose screening in date range

examples.question: How many individuals screened for blood pressure in WDF-supported facilities?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bp.patient_id) AS individuals_screened_wdf FROM bp_log_gold bp LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = bp.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count BP-screened individuals from WDF (World Diabetes Foundation) facilities

examples.question: How many individuals screened for blood pressure with elevated blood pressure?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS elevated_bp_count FROM bp_log_gold WHERE (avg_systolic >= 140 OR avg_diastolic >= 90) AND is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count individuals with elevated BP (systolic>=140 OR diastolic>=90)

examples.question: What proportion of individuals screened for blood pressure with elevated blood pressure?
examples.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN avg_systolic >= 140 OR avg_diastolic >= 90 THEN patient_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id), 0), 2) AS elevated_bp_proportion FROM bp_log_gold WHERE is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Calculate proportion of screened individuals with elevated BP

examples.question: What is the gender contribution of individuals screened for blood pressure since 2024?
examples.sql: SELECT pt.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT bp.patient_id) AS individuals_screened, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT bp.patient_id) / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT bp.patient_id)) OVER(), 2) AS percentage FROM bp_log_gold bp INNER JOIN patient_tracker_gold pt ON bp.patient_id = pt.patient_id WHERE TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' GROUP BY pt.gender ORDER BY individuals_screened DESC
examples.description: M&E: Gender breakdown of BP-screened individuals since 2024

examples.question: Develop a histogram of patients enrolled in care by 10-year age bands starting from 20 years
examples.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN pt.age < 20 THEN 'Under 20' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20-29' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30-39' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40-49' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50-59' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN '60-69' WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN '70-79' ELSE '80+' END AS age_band, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS enrolled_patients FROM patient_tracker_gold pt WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND (pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN pt.age < 20 THEN 1 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN 2 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN 3 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN 4 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN 5 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 60 AND 69 THEN 6 WHEN pt.age BETWEEN 70 AND 79 THEN 7 ELSE 8 END
examples.description: M&E: Patient enrollment distribution by 10-year age bands

examples.question: How many hypertensive patients enrolled in care are female?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS female_htn_patients FROM patient_tracker_gold WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND gender = 'Female'
examples.description: M&E: Count female patients enrolled with hypertension diagnosis

examples.question: How many patients have been enrolled in care from WDF supported facilities?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS enrolled_patients_wdf FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND (pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE) AND fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%'
examples.description: M&E: Count patients enrolled from WDF-supported facilities

examples.question: How many individuals are enrolled in care with HTN, DM, and HTN and DM?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND (is_diabetes_diagnosis = FALSE OR is_diabetes_diagnosis IS NULL) THEN patient_id END) AS htn_only, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND (is_htn_diagnosis = FALSE OR is_htn_diagnosis IS NULL) THEN patient_id END) AS dm_only, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE THEN patient_id END) AS htn_and_dm, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE THEN patient_id END) AS total_enrolled FROM patient_tracker_gold WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
examples.description: M&E: Breakdown of patients enrolled by condition type (HTN only, DM only, both)

examples.question: How many individuals enrolled in care screened for hypertension?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS enrolled_screened_htn FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN bp_log_gold bp ON pt.patient_id = bp.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND (pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE) AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count enrolled patients who have BP screenings

examples.question: How many HTN patients are enrolled in the WDF program?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS htn_patients_wdf FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%'
examples.description: M&E: Count HTN patients enrolled in WDF program

examples.question: How many DM patients are enrolled in the WDF program?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS dm_patients_wdf FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%'
examples.description: M&E: Count DM patients enrolled in WDF program

examples.question: What are the trends of patients enrolled in care in the last 3 months from WDF sites?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pt.created_at) AS enrollment_month, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS newly_enrolled FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND (pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE) AND fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%' AND pt.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pt.created_at) ORDER BY enrollment_month
examples.description: M&E: Monthly enrollment trends for last 3 months from WDF sites

examples.question: How many users completed any activity in the last 30 days from WDF facilities?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bp.created_by) AS active_users FROM bp_log_gold bp LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = bp.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%' AND TRY_CAST(bp.created_at AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count unique active users in WDF facilities in last 30 days

examples.question: Count of users by cadre who have used the system in the last 30 days
examples.sql: SELECT pr.job_title AS cadre, COUNT(DISTINCT bp.created_by) AS user_count FROM bp_log_gold bp LEFT JOIN practitioner_gold pr ON bp.created_by = pr.res_id WHERE TRY_CAST(bp.created_at AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true' GROUP BY pr.job_title ORDER BY user_count DESC
examples.description: M&E: User counts grouped by cadre/job title for last 30 days

examples.question: How many hypertensive patients with a BP follow-up in the last 3 months?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS htn_with_followup FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN bp_log_gold bp ON pt.patient_id = bp.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
examples.description: M&E: Count HTN patients with BP follow-up visits in last 3 months

examples.question: How many diabetes patients with documented blood glucose in the last 3 months?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS dm_with_glucose FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN glucose_log_gold gl ON pt.patient_id = gl.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
examples.description: M&E: Count DM patients with glucose readings in last 3 months

examples.question: How many diabetes patients with a documented HbA1c in the last 3 months?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS dm_with_hba1c FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN glucose_log_gold gl ON pt.patient_id = gl.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND gl.hba1c IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
examples.description: M&E: Count DM patients with HbA1c measurements in last 3 months

examples.question: What percentage of hypertensive patients had follow-up in 3 months?
examples.sql: WITH htn_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total FROM patient_tracker_gold WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE), htn_with_fu AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS with_followup FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN bp_log_gold bp ON pt.patient_id = bp.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true') SELECT htn_with_fu.with_followup AS htn_with_followup, htn_total.total AS total_htn_patients, ROUND(100.0 * htn_with_fu.with_followup / NULLIF(htn_total.total, 0), 2) AS followup_percentage FROM htn_total, htn_with_fu
examples.description: M&E: Percentage of HTN patients with BP follow-up in last 3 months

examples.question: What is the follow-up rate for hypertensive patients?
examples.sql: WITH htn_total AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS total FROM patient_tracker_gold WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE), htn_with_fu AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS with_followup FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN bp_log_gold bp ON pt.patient_id = bp.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(bp.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months' AND bp.is_src_deleted IS DISTINCT FROM 'true') SELECT htn_with_fu.with_followup AS htn_with_followup, htn_total.total AS total_htn_patients, ROUND(100.0 * htn_with_fu.with_followup / NULLIF(htn_total.total, 0), 2) AS followup_rate FROM htn_total, htn_with_fu
examples.description: M&E: HTN follow-up rate as percentage

examples.question: What is number and proportion of patients with controlled hypertension in the last 3 months?
examples.sql: WITH htn_patients AS (SELECT DISTINCT pt.patient_id FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN bp_log_latest_gold bl ON pt.patient_id = bl.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(bl.bp_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bl.avg_systolic < 140 AND bl.avg_diastolic < 90 THEN bl.patient_id END) AS controlled_count, COUNT(DISTINCT bl.patient_id) AS total_htn_with_reading, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN bl.avg_systolic < 140 AND bl.avg_diastolic < 90 THEN bl.patient_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT bl.patient_id), 0), 2) AS control_rate FROM bp_log_latest_gold bl WHERE bl.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM htn_patients)
examples.description: M&E: HTN control rate - number and proportion with controlled BP in last 3 months

examples.question: How many diabetes patients with controlled blood sugar?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS controlled_dm_patients FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN glucose_log_latest_gold gl ON pt.patient_id = gl.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND ((gl.glucose_type = 'Fasting' AND gl.glucose_value < 126) OR (gl.glucose_type = 'Random' AND gl.glucose_value < 200) OR (gl.hba1c IS NOT NULL AND gl.hba1c < 7))
examples.description: M&E: Count DM patients with controlled blood sugar (FBS<126, RBS<200, or HbA1c<7)

examples.question: What proportion of diabetes patients with controlled blood glucose in the last 3 months?
examples.sql: WITH dm_patients_recent AS (SELECT DISTINCT pt.patient_id FROM patient_tracker_gold pt INNER JOIN glucose_log_latest_gold gl ON pt.patient_id = gl.patient_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE AND TRY_CAST(gl.bg_taken_on AS DATE) >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (gl.glucose_type = 'Fasting' AND gl.glucose_value < 126) OR (gl.glucose_type = 'Random' AND gl.glucose_value < 200) OR (gl.hba1c IS NOT NULL AND gl.hba1c < 7) THEN gl.patient_id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT gl.patient_id), 0), 2) AS dm_control_rate FROM glucose_log_latest_gold gl WHERE gl.patient_id IN (SELECT patient_id FROM dm_patients_recent)
examples.description: M&E: DM control rate proportion in last 3 months

examples.question: How are enrolled patients distributed by county?
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, dis.name AS county_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE) SELECT f.county_name, COUNT(DISTINCT pt.patient_id) AS enrolled_patients FROM patient_tracker_gold pt LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = pt.site_id WHERE pt.is_deleted = FALSE AND (pt.is_htn_diagnosis = TRUE OR pt.is_diabetes_diagnosis = TRUE) GROUP BY f.county_name ORDER BY enrolled_patients DESC
examples.description: M&E: Patient enrollment distribution by county

examples.question: Show distribution of patients screened for BG from WDF counties
examples.sql: WITH facilities AS (SELECT hf.id AS facility_id, CAST(hf.fhir_id AS BIGINT) AS organization_id, dis.name AS county_name FROM health_facility_admin_gold hf LEFT JOIN district_admin_gold dis ON hf.district_id = dis.id WHERE hf.is_deleted = FALSE), facility_programs AS (SELECT hfp.health_facility_id AS facility_id, MAX(pg.name) AS program_name FROM health_facility_program_admin_gold hfp LEFT JOIN program_admin_gold pg ON pg.id = hfp.program_id GROUP BY hfp.health_facility_id) SELECT f.county_name, COUNT(DISTINCT gl.patient_id) AS patients_screened_bg FROM glucose_log_gold gl LEFT JOIN facilities f ON f.organization_id = gl.organization_id LEFT JOIN facility_programs fp ON fp.facility_id = f.facility_id WHERE fp.program_name ILIKE '%WDF%' GROUP BY f.county_name ORDER BY patients_screened_bg DESC
examples.description: M&E: BG screening distribution by county for WDF facilities
